contradictions.detail: Every Rapid plan article labels the evaluation loss limit 'EOD' and only the sim stage 'intra-day trailing'; S2 says Rapid plans use intraday drawdown. Evidence favours EOD; both are run.

contradictions.topic: Minimum trading days for Rapid EOD
contradictions.detail: S2's generic '2 days' is superseded by the Rapid EOD plan articles (4 days).
S18: the drawdown 'will now lock at +$100 after the drawdown % + $100 has been reached'. S4's 52.1k / 103.1k / 154.6k examples are the balance highs at which the lock happens.
S4: open equity below the minimum balance fails the account; S12: open equity losses are counted 'at the end of the trading day'. Both readings are run.
Live tables say 'static once MLL reaches $0'; account rules say 'locks at $100 above the starting balance'. S27 (150k) and S8 (100k) say $100 only.
All four Rapid plan articles: 'Once your trailing Max Loss reaches $100, it locks there'. S11's 'will not exceed the starting balance' is the generic statement.
The redesigned plan lists '3 mini / 3 micro' (6/6, 9/9) while its evaluation allows 30/60/90 micros; legacy accounts list 5/5, 10/10, 15/15. The stricter micro count is the default.
S9: 5 minis / 50 micros; S15: a Rapid 50k sim account 'starts off with 2 contracts' under a scaling plan no Rapid article describes. The stricter 20 micros is the default.

T1 is prohibited on Rapid, Rapid EOD and Pro sim funded; allowed on all evaluations and Builder. S7's '2-minute protocol for all releases' for non-T1 news is not simulated (no complete calendar of all releases).
Defined as a share of 'total evaluation profits made' but the worked example divides the profit target. The literal definition is used; the example would only change attempts that exceed the target.
Text refers to a 5% limit while formulas use 7%. Price-limit levels are not in the data, so the rule is reported as unverified, not enforced.

contradictions.topic: MFFU 2026 T1 image vs official release times
contradictions.detail: MFFU's image lists the January Employment Report on Feb 6 and CPI on Feb 11 (released Feb 11 and Feb 13) and omits the Oct 28 FOMC statement. Default blocks the union of both.
S24 says live follows standard Rapid 25k, but the Rapid live table (S23) is used because it is the only stated live table.

not_stated: The exact time an MFFU EOD balance is snapshotted (S17 fixes the 4:10 PM ET auto-flat; day-end is taken after it).
Whether unrealized P&L counts toward the EOD high-water mark (S4 states only that open losses count toward a breach).
Whether the soft daily loss limit uses realized or open (equity) P&L.
Whether every plan uses the 'one-time payment model' inactivity rule (S19).
Builder 25k / 50k live contract limits; Rapid live DLL; Pro live micro limits and lock; Pro 50k One Day sim-funded rules.
Penalties for T1 news violations (S7 gives none).

Whether ALPHA TERMINAL's unattended automated execution is permitted: S5 allows automated strategies 'tailored to their own specific settings' that do not exploit simulated fills; nothing approves this application.
Which platform API (if any) MFFU supports for automation: S6 and 'Connecting to Different Platforms' list platforms with no API or automation statement.
CME exchange and clearing fees and broker commissions (fee pages not read): all commissions are labelled scenarios.
